FILE: app/notes/inset-slide.json
```json
{
  "x": 800,
  "y": 50,
  "width": 300,
  "height": 150,
  "aspect": 2.00
}
```

I wrote the JSON using the standard normalized-to-pixel viewport conversion with a top-left origin and no clamping to the canvas. I was not certain whether the library clamps the viewport to the canvas, since the type declarations don’t specify that; if it does, the visible values would instead be `width: 200` and `aspect: 1.33`.
